note: Aetherytes the first-visit rule of the unlock index (feature plan v6 K1) cannot place: no objective of the main scenario stands within 40 yalms of them. Keys are Aetheryte sheet row ids; quests are the Quest sheet row ids that first take a character there (several when paths differ). A curated entry replaces whatever the rule inferred for that aetheryte, and the Unlocks section shows it as stated rather than likely. Every entry needs the aetheryte's name, a note and an evidence URL; notes are original wording, never wiki sentences. Where no main scenario objective stands near an aetheryte, the quest is the one the wiki lists it under, else the first whose objectives stand nearest. An aetheryte still missing would be listed in UnlockLinkReaderTests.NotYetCurated (none since 1.19).
